desc:
Hop into a fast one-shot revolver shooter, master slides and wall runs, and climb the leaderboards.

👥 Invite up to 7 friends to team up or go head-to-head
🔫 One-shot revolver and knife
🏃 Slide, wall run, vault and climb
⚔️ Free For All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag & Gun Game
🗳️ Vote on the next map
📦 Open cases for revolver, knife & katana skins
💀 Show off your eliminations with kill effects
🎟️ Arena Pass, daily quests and level-up rewards
🏆 Climb the Kills, Wins & Level leaderboards

Skins are cosmetic only. No pay-to-win!

🖥️ PC: Shoot — M1 · Aim / Stab — M2 · Slide — Ctrl / C · Reload — R · Swap — Q · Jump — Space
🎮 Controller: Shoot — R2 · Aim / Stab — L2 · Slide — B · Reload — X · Swap — Y · Jump — A
📱 Mobile: on-screen buttons you can move and resize, plus aim assist

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
